newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cegetel EPS be positive in 1997 for CGE.
newsitem.headline: Cegetel EPS be positive in 1997 for CGE.

text.p: Cie Generale des Eaux will not suffer any earnings dilution this year and expects a positive effect in 1997 from the creation of its Cegetal telecommunications joint venture, chairman Jean-Marie Messier said on Wednesday.
"The creation of Cegetel will certainly not have a dilutive impact on Generale des Eaux, it should have a positive impact on net earnings per share in 1997," he told a news conference.
British Telecommunications Plc chairman Iain Vallance said his company's investment in Cegetal would be "marginally dilutive."

Messier declined to give detailed figure for the estimated return on equity for Cegetel but said based on the experience of Generale des Eaux's SFR mobile telephone unit, it has had a return on investment much higher than 20 percent
"What we have seen in SFR, and with our hopes for Cegetel's success, lead us to consider a good business in which we see a return on investment much higher than 20 percent," he said.
Generale des Eaux said SFR has captured 40 percent of the French mobile phone market, versus 15 percent in 1995 and has over 700,000 customers.
